reviews.body:
**[SkillSpector Review]**

### Value and readiness
The expanded table improves early validation for the added families, but deliberately treating Mythos5.1 as sampling-capable leaves the same documented failure path unhandled.

### Material findings
**Required — `src/skillspector/providers/structured_output.py:58-65`, `tests/unit/test_model_capabilities.py:111-112`, and `tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py:436-438`.** The PR excludes claude-mythos-5-1 on the stated basis that no published sampling statement exists and explicitly asserts it keeps sampling. Anthropic's current [Fable/Mythos migration guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/migration-guide) says Mythos shares Fable's capabilities, describes their shared baseline, and carries the sampling restriction forward from Opus5 in a section whose migration examples include both models. Taken together, those published statements support applying the same restriction to Mythos5.1; the PR's no-evidence premise is no longer accurate. At this head the model matcher returns false for that ID, so an explicit SKILLSPECTOR_TEMPERATURE=0.2 passes resolve_sampling_parameters into the request rather than raising the promised UnsupportedControlError. Add the documented Mythos5.1 family to the rejection policy, replace the permissive assertion/Bedrock fixture and cover its routed identifiers. If platform-specific behavior differs, provide authoritative evidence and encode that distinction explicitly.

### PIC tradeoffs
The existing native-endpoint default-value compatibility exception is outside this table-only correction. Unknown future families should not be assigned capabilities without evidence.

### Verification and gaps
Read all six changed files and pinned matching/normalization, sampling resolver and provider call paths; inspected all new positive/negative cases and prior empty review/thread state. Independently read current official Opus, Haiku and Fable/Mythos migration guides and API reference. No live provider request was made; the finding combines the published contract with a source-level forwarding trace. All six hosted checks succeeded; they currently encode the permissive Mythos assumption rather than detecting this gap. No contributor code, tests, snippets, imports, builds, model calls or scanner invocations were executed.

Reviewed head: `0ac9b3827ff6d42f8b2c6d4c01722878e08c0dbd`.

**[SkillSpector Review]**

### Value and readiness
The earlier Mythos omission is resolved. The change now provides the intended early unsupported-control error across the documented Claude families, including Mythos, and is ready for maintainer/PIC final review.

### Material findings
Prior blocker resolved: claude-mythos-5 is in SAMPLING_REJECTED_MODELS; bare, dated, Bedrock and gateway Mythos IDs have rejecting assertions; the Bedrock fixture rejects explicit temperature and succeeds without it. The original permissive expectation is removed. Reviewed the complete family table and model-name boundary logic, docs, provider call sites and all changed tests; no further required changes found.

### PIC tradeoffs
None identified for this table expansion. The existing native-endpoint temperature=1.0 compatibility exception is unchanged; this approval does not assert fresh live acceptance of every model/route.

### Verification and gaps
Read the full six-file diff, exact-head source/tests and provider context, prior marked review and author reply. Rechecked Anthropic's [joint Fable/Mythos migration guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/migration-guide), which carries the sampling restriction forward and provides the corresponding Mythos migration. All six hosted checks succeeded. No live provider call or contributor code/tests were executed locally.

Reviewed head: `71180bcf18c54f8da87b7e6717c35bd7ad9f0470`.

comments.body:
Thanks, agreed: added `claude-mythos-5` to the sampling-rejection table (covers `claude-mythos-5-1`, dated snapshots and routed Bedrock/gateway IDs), replaced the permissive assertion and the Bedrock fixture, and added routed-ID cases. Provider and capability tests pass.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
